entries.title: Job 22:1
segments: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

entries.title: Job 22:2
segments: Can a man be profitable unto God? Surely he that is wise is profitable unto himself.

entries.title: Job 22:3
segments: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gain [to him], that thou makest thy ways perfect?

entries.title: Job 22:4
segments: Is it for thy fear [of him] that he reproveth thee, That he entereth with thee into judgment?

entries.title: Job 22:5
segments: Is not thy wickedness great? Neither is there any end to thine iniquities.

entries.title: Job 22:6
segments: For thou hast taken pledges of thy brother for nought, And stripped the naked of their clothing.

entries.title: Job 22:7
segments: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, And thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

entries.title: Job 22:8
segments: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; And the honorable man, he dwelt in it.

entries.title: Job 22:9
segments: Thou hast sent widows away empty, And the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

entries.title: Job 22:10
segments: Therefore snares are round about thee, And sudden fear troubleth thee,

entries.title: Job 22:11
segments: Or darkness, so that thou canst not see, And abundance of waters cover thee.

entries.title: Job 22:12
segments: Is not God in the height of heaven? And behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

entries.title: Job 22:13
segments: And thou sayest, What doth God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

entries.title: Job 22:14
segments: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he seeth not; And he walketh on the vault of heaven.

entries.title: Job 22:15
segments: Wilt thou keep the old way Which wicked men have trodden?

entries.title: Job 22:16
segments: Who were snatched away before their time, Whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

entries.title: Job 22:17
segments: Who said unto God, Depart from us; And, What can the Almighty do for us?

entries.title: Job 22:18
segments: Yet he filled their houses with good things: But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

entries.title: Job 22:19
segments: The righteous see it, and are glad; And the innocent laugh them to scorn,

entries.title: Job 22:20
segments: [Saying], Surely they that did rise up against us are cut off, And the remnant of them the fire hath consumed.

entries.title: Job 22:21
segments: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: Thereby good shall come unto thee.

entries.title: Job 22:22
segments: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, And lay up his words in thy heart.

entries.title: Job 22:23
segments: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, If thou put away unrighteousness far from thy tents.

entries.title: Job 22:24
segments: And lay thou [thy] treasure in the dust, And [the gold of] Ophir among the stones of the brooks;

entries.title: Job 22:25
segments: And the Almighty will be thy treasure, And precious silver unto thee.

entries.title: Job 22:26
segments: For then shalt thou delight thyself in the Almighty, And shalt lift up thy face unto God.

entries.title: Job 22:27
segments: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he will hear thee; And thou shalt pay thy vows.

entries.title: Job 22:28
segments: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee; And light shall shine upon thy ways.

entries.title: Job 22:29
segments: When they cast [thee] down, thou shalt say, [There is] lifting up; And the humble person he will save.

entries.title: Job 22:30
segments: He will deliver [even] him that is not innocent: Yea, he shall be delivered through the cleanness of thy hands.
